## Checklist

- [ ] `npm run build` passes locally (copy lint, link check, honesty gate).
- [ ] No draft banner was removed, weakened, or moved.
- [ ] No `[COUNSEL: …]` marker was removed — or, if one was, this description says **who
      resolved it and how**. "It reads fine now" is not a resolution; only counsel resolves a
      counsel marker.
- [ ] No `{{TOKEN}}` was replaced with a value that nobody has decided. Undecided constants
      belong in `placeholders.json` with what blocks them.
- [ ] Nothing added reads as operative, launched, available, or endorsed.
- [ ] No impact figure, currency amount, or adoption count was added.
- [ ] No confidential, privileged, or internal material from any organization is included.
- [ ] If this reverses a recorded decision, it is filed as an issue instead of a diff.
